title.narrative: Promotion of energy security and sustainable growth through increased energy and resource efficiency in tourism SMEs in Kyrgyzstan (PERETO)

description.narrative: PERETO aims to promote energy security and sustainable growth through advancement of SCP practices and ERE in the tourism sector of Kyrgyzstan, particularly focusing on HoReCa SMEs. PERETO builds upon existing programmes like the EU-supported KyrSEFF, by enhancing capacities of target SMEs and developing new financing instruments. It also aims to accelerate the market for ERE measures by advancing the policy discourse and establishing a voluntary ER.
